thread:
mira: Flagging a quickstart mismatch: the Dedicated quickstart examples still reference old fields and a deprecated CLI flow. Not urgent but we should sweep before next release.

owen: what's wrong specifically?

mira: Main things I found: YAML uses `scalePolicy` (camelCase) but runtime expects `scale_policy` now; autoscale docs mention `min_replicas` but our autoscaler uses `min_replicas` only when `policy: replicas` is set (confusing); CLI example shows `redwood capacity allocate` which was renamed to `redwood capacity create`. Also Terraform snippet references provider v1 attr `reservedPool`.

patch-bot: snippet-gen: queued regeneration for resource `dedicated_capacity` at commit c12d9. New snippets will be available at https://internal/snips/4991 once CI finishes.

frank: I can take the YAML + terraform edits. Proposed compact YAML to replace quickstart block:

```yaml
reserved_pool: "engineering-pool"
scale_policy:
  policy: replicas
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  cooldown_seconds: 180
labels:
  preemptible: "false"
  isolate_on_eviction: "true"
```

frank: Note: add a short parenthetical that `min_replicas` is only honored for `policy: replicas` to avoid confusion.

legal: quick note from Legal: the quickstart currently reads like an SLA promise: "Pools have 99.9% uptime." Please reword to: "Redwood reports availability per reserved-pool-shard; see SLA matrix for details." Add that as a footnote.

mira: Good catch. devex, can you update the SDK snippets (python/ts) to use `create_capacity` and the new waiter helper name `wait_for_ready_capacity()`? Also clarify the polling example uses exponential backoff.

devex: Yep, taking SDKs. I'll also add a one-line migration bullets section at the top with exact mappings: `scalePolicy -> scale_policy`, `reservedPool -> reserved_pool`, `capacity allocate -> capacity create`.

owen: I'll add a tiny "Behavior during cooldown" inline note: "During cooldown_seconds no scale-ups are triggered; burst settings may permit short-lived overcommit but do not bypass cooldown." Keep it 2 lines.

mira: Plan: frank -> YAML + TF; devex -> SDK + migration bullets; owen -> autoscale note; legal -> footnote wording (will paste into PR). Patch-bot will regen snippets and I'll open a single aggregated PR to update quickstart. Target: merge before next docs snapshot.

patch-bot: snippet-gen: regenerated Python, TypeScript, YAML, Terraform examples for `dedicated_capacity` at commit c12d9. Preview: https://internal/snips/4991 (internal).

frank: pushed branch `docs/dedicated-quickstart-sweep` with YAML and TF edits and included the new snippet links in the PR body.

devex: SDK updates pushed. Using `create_capacity` and `wait_for_ready_capacity()` in both python and ts examples. Added exponential backoff note.

mira: Thanks all. Quick nit: prefer term "tenant unit" in migration bullets instead of just "tenant" to avoid ambiguity across docs. If no objections I'll squash and merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
